# Version 4.156.0 (Unreleased)
> **Platform updates and runtime fixes**

## Highlights

Upcoming changes improve native callback correctness, Linux shaping stability, and Android frame pacing.

## Breaking Changes

- **Raise Apple deployment targets** — Native SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp now require macOS 11 and iOS/tvOS/Mac Catalyst 14. Managed iOS/tvOS minimums rise to 14; managed macOS 12 and Mac Catalyst 15 minimums stay higher. Raise application deployment targets to the applicable managed/framework floor, not merely the native minimum. ([#5383](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5383))
- **Migrate Uno applications to Uno 7** — The Uno views now use Uno 7 and .NET 10; old native-renderer variants and pre-Uno 7 WasmShell pipelines are retired. Non-Windows SKSwapChainPanel is a Grid-backed CPU fallback with null GRContext and no RaiseOnUnsupported member; use SKCanvasElement for GPU rendering. Windows keeps its ANGLE-backed facade. Use the .NET SDK WASM pipeline and matching product packages. ([#5377](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5377))
- **Keep SKData copy lengths within the source array** — SKData.CreateCopy(byte[], ulong) now throws ArgumentOutOfRangeException when the requested length exceeds the array. Pass a length within the source array instead of relying on an out-of-bounds native read. ([#5429](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5429))

## Bug Fixes

- **Ganesh GLES uploads** — Disables BGRA8-as-RGBx uploads that advertised GL_RGBA and were invalid in GLES. Readback behavior is unchanged. ([#5500](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5500))
- **Runtime shader validation** — Rejects Raster Pipeline slot-count and temporary-stack overflow before allocation, and rejects reserved sampler2D and texture2D runtime-effect types during parsing. ([#5489](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5489))
- **Native callback boolean widths** — Corrects Skia callbacks to one-byte native booleans and HarfBuzz callbacks to four-byte hb_bool_t values, including false-return handling. Public managed delegates still use bool. ([#5479](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5479))
- **Character-code and null-input validation** — StringUtilities.GetUnicodeCharacterCode validates the encoded width and decodes one unit correctly: ASCII for UTF-8, BMP for UTF-16, and full code points for UTF-32. GetString(null, encoding) now throws ArgumentNullException rather than NullReferenceException. ([#5506](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5506))
- **Linux HarfBuzz load-order crashes** — Binds internal calls to the bundled HarfBuzz implementation, preventing system HarfBuzz loaded by GTK from redirecting calls between incompatible native objects. Exported entry points and managed signatures are unchanged. — ❤️ [@VirgilMing](https://github.com/VirgilMing) ([#5352](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5352))
- **Display-paced Android texture rendering** — Automatic continuous GLTextureView rendering, including MAUI SKGLView.HasRenderLoop, follows display callbacks instead of swap throughput. Explicit render requests remain independent, and drawing stays on the GL worker. ([#5345](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5345))
- **WebGPU application linking** — Includes emdawnwebgpu C++ support in libSkiaSharp.a instead of compiling it on the application link line, avoiding C/C++ flag conflicts. JavaScript glue remains a link input; newer consumers require matching rebuilt archives. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#5316](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5316))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Less image and shaping allocation** — Managed pixel copies avoid an intermediate SKData allocation when direct copying is valid. HarfBuzz UTF-32 string insertion reuses encoding storage, and feature formatting avoids native string allocation while preserving decoding behavior. ([#5052](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5052), [#5060](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5060), [#5230](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5230))
- **Release borrowed stream references** — Disposing SKFrontBufferedManagedStream clears its reference to a wrapped stream even when disposeUnderlyingStream is false. The borrowed stream is not disposed; its caller remains responsible for disposal. ([#5327](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5327))

## Platform

- **Windows library refresh** — Aligns Windows library dependencies with Windows App SDK 1.7.250909003 and refreshes the bundled WinUI ANGLE dependency to chromium/8118. These changes do not raise the declared Windows runtime minimum. ([#5390](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5390), [#5321](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5321))
